public.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
public.description: Return the rightmost visible value at each depth, from root downward. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: the first value is the root; each non-null node consumes the next two entries as left and right children. Null marks a missing child; trailing nulls may be omitted. Empty arrays mean no tree. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000, with at most 200 nodes.
hints: Process one breadth-first level at a time.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The last node of each left-to-right breadth-first level is visible from the right. O(n) time and O(n) space.
